title: Silence and Aftermath
author: Vesper Ravensworth
blurb: Ines Villalobos, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, has spent five years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
